_purpose: Reference copy of the hooks registered in .claude/settings.json. Claude Code reads settings.json — this file is for documentation only.
_how_to_install: 1. Copy the entire .claude/hooks/ directory into your project's .claude/hooks/
2. Put project-specific settings in <project>/.claude/hooks.config.json (leave the shared .claude/hooks/config.json unchanged)
3. Merge the 'hooks' block below into your project's .claude/settings.json
4. Run: node .claude/hooks/session-start.cjs  to verify orientation output

PreToolUse._purpose: Block file writes that violate architecture rules defined in config.json (arch_rules)

Require description (bash_description_guard) + warn on dependency installs (dep_guard) + validate npm run scripts exist (script_guard) + enforce commit message structure (commit_guard) + pre-push diff audit (push_audit) + block deleting a branch an open PR still bases off (branch_delete_guard) + unconditionally block PR/protected-branch merges (merge_guard) + nudge away from raw grep/find/cat/head/tail (search_guard)

PostToolUse._purpose: Content validation (content_watch) + theater test detection (empty_test_guard) + TODO format (todo_format)
After a real git push, block until the matching GitHub Actions run completes and report the real result (ci_status_check) — a local test pass is not proof of a green remote run

SessionStart._purpose: Print project orientation banner once when a session starts

_exit_codes.1: Validation failed (PostToolUse hooks — informs Claude of failure)
_exit_codes.2: Block action (PreToolUse hooks — Claude Code rejects the tool call and shows stderr)

_stdin_payload._note: All hook commands receive the tool call as JSON on stdin
